t: OB21 Premium Shower & Bath Silicone, a professional-grade acetic curing sealant, is engineered for creating durable, watertight seals around sanitary ware. This high-performance white silicone is ideal for installations in bathrooms and kitchens, including baths, showers, basins, and other ceramic fixtures, effectively preventing water ingress and protecting against moisture damage. It remains permanently elastic, ensuring lasting flexibility, and offers exceptional water, UV, and weather-resistance, suitable for both interior and exterior applications. The formulation is mould and mildew-resistant, preserving a clean finish, and is solvent-free with low VOC levels for user safety.
b: For Use on Baths, Showers, Basins & Sanitaryware
